I will apply urea fertilizer on my maize plot because the government voucher makes it affordable, and I will plant improved seed since I have seen it produces bigger cobs than local maize when fertilizer is used. I do not have enough manure for this whole field, and we cannot irrigate here in Kigoma because we depend entirely on the single rainy season from November to April. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes, but I will hire a few young men from the village to help with weeding when the rains come and the weeds grow fast. I will not buy pesticides for maize because pest damage has never been bad enough to justify the cost.
